This last weekend I went hog hunting for the first time. We took our guns but we were mostly just getting to know the area. A friend got in touch with a nice single lady who had some good land she was happy to share with us. This was an area with a pond, spring, and about 22 acres, about a third swamp, and two thirds forest. Not a lot but just enough to do some hog hunting or deer hunting. While scouting the area we saw some pig prints, mostly smaller ones but one set of VERY big ones, as well as fresh deer droppings. Might be a good place to try deer hunting later this year.

The weapon of choice is a Mossberg 12 gauge with a factory bead sight loaded with slugs. I was thinking I was silly hunting with a self-defense shotgun but then I noticed I wanted to put a green light on it and because I had a more tactical gun it was easy to do that! :) From what I read pigs can’t see the green light, they just maybe see a slight glow on the fashlight just as we see a dull glow from an infrared light. I don’t have to hunt at night but now it is an option.

The bigger the better but if I can pull off shooting a 50-150lb hog I think we can have an awesome bbq by roasting it whole! If I get a huge one I will probably try to turn it into sausage.

I will probably shoot for the vitals, the front bottom where the heart and lugs are. I have a bead site and I am good to about 40 yards. When I have the money I may get a nice optic.

There was a feeder abandoned there so we bought a battery and corn and set it to feed twice per day. We will be going back next week. I will also bring a nice gift for the lady who is letting us hunt on her land.

Next week I will try to post pictures of the small swamp and forest in case anyone is interested. Should be fun!
